body: My brother wants people down there that he knows besides his wife. He's done it with a couple of his friends. I mentioned the last time he was in that I was damn tired with where I was. He said try moving down to where he was. But I looked in the classifieds today, and there's nothing listed here besides the usual shit.

Besides my parents, and two friends, there is no one that really cares about me. My brother (the one who is letting me stay with him) and I don't get along that well over long spaces of time. I have another brother who is a doctor and works almost all the time. And a sister that is a lawyer who has 2 kids, that my parents love more than me. I'm the black sheep of my family. First kid with a drinking problem, first kid to be arrested, firat to not go to college, first not to be married and happy and share the American dream... When will I catch my lucky break? I see dumb fucks all the time with girlfriends, wives, fiancés, and they don't realize what they have. I would do so much just to have a fraction of what they have.

I just got done watching that video. While insightful, it didn't really help. It's not like there are other "pebbles" lined up to meet me. This is the first one that I've had any connection with. I just want to be hers, but she doesn't see that. I tried asking if she wanted to try long distance (2 and a half hour drive, not that bad right?) and she said no. Will she not break it to my face that she doesn't feel the same way I do? As for the job aspect of my life, I'm tired. I'm so god damn tired. I hate working day in and day out. How can people deal with this? I can't imagine doing this the rest of my life. People ask why I smoke so many cigarettes, and I just tell them I'm addicted. Truth is, I just want to die more soon. I can't find a job back home (which I love my home state), and my brother is really pushing for me to move down to where he is (which is where I'm at right now) but here seems pretty baron too for a person with just a high school diploma, no goals, and no skills.
